description: Reduce crash likelihood, "Not Initialized" incidents, and cross-machine persistence failures before expanding scope. This is the hardening gate that must pass before other phases can safely proceed.

- [ ] Fresh install from Release ZIP on Qt6 QGIS passes all checks
